nodes.label: ScaleForge Production-Grade Monolith Template
nodes.author: Harmeet Singh
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive monolith template chosen over microservices for simplicity with production-grade features including auth, search, notifications, payments, and permissions

nodes.label: JWT Authentication System
nodes.rationale: JWT with refresh token rotation chosen for stateless auth with secure session management via Redis

nodes.label: Google Gemini AI Integration
nodes.rationale: Gemini used for vector embeddings to enable semantic search alongside Elasticsearch full-text search

nodes.label: OpenFGA Permissions
nodes.rationale: OpenFGA chosen for relationship-based access control supporting RBAC and ABAC with dynamic evaluation

nodes.label: Prometheus K8s Deployment
nodes.rationale: 30-day retention with 50Gi gp3 storage, runs as non-root with alertmanager integration

nodes.label: Loki Log Aggregation K8s Deployment
nodes.rationale: Single replica with boltdb-shipper and filesystem storage, rate-limited ingestion at 8MB/s, read-only root filesystem for security

nodes.label: Fluent Bit Log Forwarder
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Promtail as log collector; tails container logs and forwards to Loki

nodes.label: Health Feature Testing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses Node.js built-in test runner (no external deps) with 3-tier testing: unit (<100ms), integration (<5s), E2E (<30s), totaling 35 test cases
